evidence.quote: Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon, not at close.

observations.why: Stated as an operational rule and policy timing rather than a proposal or debatable claim.

evidence.quote: At close nobody is left to buy them.

observations.why: Unhedged factual assertion provided as the justification for the policy.

evidence.quote: Then the shelf card changes at two as well

observations.why: Establishes a synchronized operational procedure alongside the timing rule.
